orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice V. K. Bist
orders.text:
CRLR No.114 of 2017 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Manoj Mohan, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
Mr. Pradeep Chamyal, Advocate for 
the respondent. 
Since the matter has arisen out of 
the matrimonial dispute, hence, in the 
opinion of the Court, an attempt should 
be made by the parties for mediation. 
Learned counsel for the parties 
also agreed for mediation. 
As requested, list this matter on 
20.07.2017. Parties to appear on 
20.07.2017. Noting their presence, 
parties will be referred for mediation on 
that date. 
 
 
(Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 29.06.2017 
Rajni

 Heard learned counsel for the

Today, respondent is present, but 
revisionist could not come before this 
Court. 
Learned counsel for the parties 
submitted that the parties are ready for 
mediation. They further submitted that 
some date may be fixed for the same. 
List this matter on 04.08.2017 for 
mediation. Parties to appear on

will be referred for mediation on the same 
day.
